\uses{Complexity.SpaceConstructible}
For every natural number $c$ with $1\leq c$, the function $n\mapsto n^c+1$ is space
constructible: for every $n$, its logarithmic space bound is at most $n^c+1$, and there
exist a positive natural number $d$ and a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
that, on every Boolean input $x$, outputs the binary representation of $|x|^c+1$ using
at most $d(|x|^c+1)$ work-tape cells.
\end{theorem}

  {Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.outerSt_s}
  {context}

  {pdf-c8033d2fd705-p004-b001}
\uses{Complexity.NSPACE, Complexity.SPACE, Complexity.SpaceConstructible}
Let $S\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $\log_2 n+1\le S(n)$ for every $n$, and
suppose that for some positive integer $c$ there is a finite deterministic Turing
machine that, on every binary input $x$, outputs the binary representation of $S(|x|)$
using at most $cS(|x|)$ work-tape cells. Then every language decidable by a finite
nondeterministic Turing machine using at most a constant multiple of $S(n)$ work-tape
cells is decidable by a finite deterministic Turing machine using at most a constant
multiple of $S(n)^2$ work-tape cells.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Equality of polynomial space classes]
\lean{Complexity.PSPACE_eq_NPSPACE}
\statementsource{Sav70}{
  pdf-c8033d2fd705-p003-b005,
  pdf-c8033d2fd705-p004-b001,
  pdf-c8033d2fd705-p008-b002,
  pdf-c8033d2fd705-p008-b003
}
\label{Complexity.PSPACE_eq_NPSPACE}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.NPSPACE, Complexity.NPSPACE_subset_PSPACE, Complexity.PSPACE, Complexity.PSPACE_subset_NPSPACE}
\difficulty{1}
The class of languages decidable by deterministic finite Turing machines using at most a
polynomial number of work-tape cells equals the class of languages decidable by
nondeterministic finite Turing machines using at most a polynomial number of work-tape
cells. In both classes, the polynomial bound has the form $c(n^d+1)$ for some natural
numbers $c,d$, and the nondeterministic machines must halt within some finite number of
steps on every branch for each input.
\end{theorem}
